Figure 1: The LLM-XTM architecture enhances a VAE-based topic model using a dual-alignment strategy guided by a Large Language Model (LLM). The LLM first refines the model’s topic–word sets, producing semantically cleaner top-word lists (β → βrefined). To ensure consistency between the original and refined topic representations, an MMD loss (Lmmd) encourages the original top-word distributions to stay close to the refined ones, preserving the latent semantic structure while enhancing coherence. Finally, a document-level alignment loss (Ldoc-align) matches the model’s inferred document–topic distributions (θ) with the LLM-induced semantic targets (θ̂), enforcing cross-lingual consistency across documents and topics.
